title: Column footer
description: The bottom of a soft grey inset panel: a large, faint, embossed-looking wordmark on the left and airy link columns on the right (navy headings, grey links on generous 44px rows, a long product list split over two columns). Links darken over 0.2s on hover. Phones stack everything.
notes: continues column-cta's inset panel; set open={false} to give it its own rounded top when used alone
a group with columns: 2 splits its links over two columns on desktop
